innovation.summary: The project focuses on the development and enhancement of QuantumGL, an open-source software tool designed for visualizing the dynamics of electron orbital states. By making the full source code and modifications available under the same open license, the project aims to ensure accessibility and continuous improvement of the tool, which will also serve as a web resource for teaching quantum mechanics.
key_points: QuantumGL is an open-source software tool for visualizing electron orbital states.

Modifications to QuantumGL will be made available, promoting continuous improvement.
QuantumGL will serve as a web resource for teaching quantum mechanics online.
Computer aided visualization is employed to make Quantum Mechanics more accessible.
